description: This abstract, loosely rendered landscape features a large, light brown mesa with layers of pink earth at its top and bottom. A few grayish-brown trees with hints of blue sit on a pink and white slope leading up to the plateau. These elements contrast with a vibrant blue, cloudless sky.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Texas Landscape)
